title: Structured porting instructions
description: Optional operator-authored intent for one selection. These fields explain the requested adaptation; they do not grant permissions or change host-enforced scope and verification.

goal.description: Required detailed statement of the behavior to port. Keep description as the short rule summary.

adaptation.description: Optional target-specific implementation guidance. Omitted arrays normalize to empty arrays.

nonGoals.description: Optional explicit exclusions for this selection. Omitted arrays normalize to empty arrays.

instructionText.description: Single-line, trimmed-nonempty valid Unicode text of at most 4096 code points. Rejects C0/DEL controls, Unicode line separators, and unpaired UTF-16 surrogates.
